newsitem.title: USA: April retail sales weaken from March.
newsitem.headline: April retail sales weaken from March.

text.p: Sales at retail stores were down broadly in April, the Commerce Department said on Tuesday, partly because of weaker demand for new cars and a slower pace of department-store sales.

Total retail sales declined last month by 0.3 percent to a seasonally adjusted $212.2 billion -- the largest drop since June last year -- after a revision to show flat sales in March instead of a 0.1 percent pickup.
